prior_information_disclosure: Existing plans, literature, and world-level NFA audits were read. The source schema and first Afghan historical rows were inspected during source discovery; no new paired country endpoint changes were computed before this specification. This is not a pristine or externally registered preregistration. F04 subsequently inspected country-boundary geometry, a 2015 identifier inventory, product endpoint availability and valid/zero/missing native-cell counts in fixed local windows; no national physical stocks or change signs were estimated. During territory checking, single-year 2015 account forest-area and population values were also inspected; they were not used as independent forest validation or to compute paired country changes. Later source-discovery searches also exposed published third-party forest-trend headlines/statistics; candidate countries and probe locations were not changed. No outcome-naive source-selection or independent held-out-validation claim is made. F05 subsequently inspected the two MapBiomas Collection 11 cover arrays on the unchanged F04 Brazil window, their local category areas and endpoint patterns. Those observations are not an untouched held-out evaluation. Operational groups were frozen before decoding these arrays. F06 subsequently inspected both public reference archives, endpoint-label completeness, training/weight fields and coordinate/payload discrepancies. The local footprint was not moved after discovering the reference gap; no reference-versus-map accuracy was computed. F07 subsequently computed auxiliary full-cell masses and minimal-model allocation/difference sets for both fixed mapped groups. The existing local cover and zero/valid outcomes were known before the F07 specification. No untouched held-out or outcome-naive claim is made; both group difference sets are reported regardless of sign. XLSX inspection was metadata-only, not a completed reference audit. F08 subsequently downloaded and streamed the complete public XLSX reference representation under an explicit workbook-only limit exception. Its per-ID common annual payloads, coordinate and role tokens match the CSV after stated serialization normalization; it supplies no extra local paired endpoint labels. This is an inspected source-equivalence audit, not independent or held-out validation.
